checks: standard and pressure complete through ordinary dispatch, work timers and walking
professions and circuit isolation constrain real orders
parallel roles work concurrently and isolation takes actual travel and time
power requires a completed repair and a separate dispatcher reconnection
medical stabilization consumes exactly one kit and treatment requires electricity
air worsens before repair and recovers only after sealing, power and ventilation
a new incident creates obstacles and BFS reroutes around the corridor hazard
a travelling actor reroutes after the fire appears without entering blocked cells
evacuation depends on the beacon, power, breathable air and all medical work
evacuation walks patients to their docking spots and never grants instant arrival
winning requires crew walking too, after the final dispatcher task
pausing freezes everything including travel and work progress
neglecting duties can lose through health and a closed evacuation window
moving cancels an unfinished job without applying its completion
in-progress saves resume deterministically and remain paused on load
save validation rejects invented counts, fake arrivals, alien jobs and broken paths
all equipment destinations resolve to floor routes rather than the equipment cell
method: Production simulation and ordinary dispatch actions; no synthetic progress, health or arrival grants. Both scenarios complete normally.
